en.headline: School bus and private car collide in Tung Chung, nine taken to hospital
en.dek: A nanny and eight children under six were among those sent for checks after the head-on crash on Wui Tung Street near Yu Nga Court shortly before 9 a.m.
body: A school bus carrying young children collided head-on with a private car on Wui Tung Street in Tung Chung on Monday morning, sending nine people to hospital for treatment or checks.

Police said the crash occurred at about 8.51 a.m. near Yu Nga Court. The private car was turning right into an unnamed road when it struck the school bus, which was travelling towards Tung Chung town centre. Both vehicles sustained damage to their right front sections.

A female nanny on the school bus reported lower back pain and was conscious when taken to hospital. Eight children under the age of six who were also on board were sent for medical checks; all were reported to be in stable condition. The private-car driver and a passenger were uninjured.
Officers are investigating the cause of the collision.

zh.headline: 東涌校巴與私家車迎頭相撞 9人送院包括學童
zh.dek: 今早約8時51分匯東街近裕雅苑發生車禍，校巴上一名保母及8名未滿6歲學童送院檢驗，學童傷勢輕微。
body: 東涌今早發生涉及校巴的交通意外，一輛載有多名學童的校巴與一輛私家車在匯東街迎頭相撞，共9人送院。
警方指，事故於上午約8時51分在匯東街近裕雅苑發生。私家車沿匯東街右轉入無名路期間，與一輛往東涌市中心方向行駛的校巴相撞，兩車右邊車頭損毀。
校巴上一名女保母報稱腰痛，清醒送院；車上8名未滿6歲學童亦一同送院檢驗，全部學童傷勢輕微。私家車司機及一名乘客沒有受傷。
